subject: Staged sweep & payment waterfall playbook for annual prepay
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBay Labs Finance <finance@brightbay.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay cadence — proposal and VAT question

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. As BrightBay gets our 2027 budget lined up, we want to confirm the mechanics for the annual prepay (committed spend) and the monthly/quarterly drawdown windows. A few specific asks:

- Can you provide an example waterfall for a EUR 480k annual prepay split across quarterly sweeps (how invoices would look and when drawdowns hit)?
- We are EU-registered for VAT (IE - 6543210), but need to confirm whether Redwood will invoice gross with VAT or provide a net invoice and rely on reverse charge.
- We need sample invoice lines (unit price per 1k tokens, reserved capacity fees, monthly run-rate) to get PO approval.

Attached is our internal capex timing spreadsheet for 2027. Can Kimberly or finance ops at Redwood flag anything we should change to meet our AP cutoffs?

Appreciate quick guidance — procurement deadline is Nov 12.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance, BrightBay Labs
liam@brightbay.com
+353 1 234 5678

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence — proposal and VAT question

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. Putting the quick answers up front, then a recommended staged plan below:

Short answers:
- We can support a quarterly sweep waterfall for a EUR 480k commitment (we typically issue a schedule of four invoices or one upfront + staged release schedule depending on customer preference).
- For EU-registered customers with valid VAT IDs we can issue net invoices under reverse-charge; if BrightBay requires Redwood to collect VAT we will invoice gross — let us know the preference and provide a VAT cert.

Proposed staged sweep (recommended, minimizes timing mismatch with AP):
1) Deposit: 40% upfront invoice (EUR 192,000) due on signature — clears budget hold.
2) Quarter 1 sweep (EUR 96,000) invoiced on Jan 1 as scheduled drawdown 1.
3) Quarter 2 sweep (EUR 96,000) invoiced Apr 1.
4) Quarter 3 sweep (EUR 48,000) invoiced Jul 1 (we recommend partial to account for usage variance).
5) Quarter 4 sweep (EUR 48,000) invoiced Oct 1 with final reconciliation invoice for any usage overages/credits.

Invoice lines (sample for Q1 invoice):
- Committed capacity (quarterly tranche) — EUR 96,000
- Monthly reserved capacity allocation (Jan pro rata) — EUR 32,000
- API overage (tokens) — EUR 0.00 (Billed only if exceeded)
- Net total: EUR 96,000 (VAT handling per preference)

We typically include PO number on the invoice and can provide GL coding and a single CSV ledger export each month. I've attached a draft commitment schedule that maps these values to your uploaded sheet.

Next steps:
- Confirm VAT handling (reverse-charge vs Redwood collect).
- If reverse-charge: confirm BrightBay VAT ID and we will put the VAT line as 0 and reference reverse-charge on the invoice.
- If Redwood to collect VAT: we will re-issue sample invoices with VAT at 23% (or applicable country rate) and provide gross totals for AP.

Cc'ing Kimberly for payment terms language and Jonas for reconciliation/export format. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you'd like to walk the schedule with procurement.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: BrightBay_2027_commitment_schedule.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence — procurement / VAT clarifications

Liam, Mina — quick notes from procurement/billing ops: 

- AP cutoffs: if BrightBay's AP processes at month-end (EOM) we recommend invoice issue dates to align to the first business day of each quarter to ensure the cash actually clears in the quarter. The 40% upfront should be issued on signature with a 30-day due; if you need net-30 vs net-45 call it out.
- VAT: to apply reverse-charge we need BrightBay's EU VAT ID (format and validation screenshot preferred). If you prefer Redwood to collect VAT then the PO should include the gross amount.
- PO and remit: please confirm the remit bank account name and SWIFT — we will include the bank details on the invoice but procurement needs the exact remit string for their system.

Operational ask for BrightBay AP: please send a short confirmation email with the following so we can lock invoices:
1) Preferred VAT handling: reverse-charge or Redwood collects VAT
2) Final remit details (bank/IBAN/SWIFT)
3) PO number to place on the first invoice

I can produce a sample invoice (PDF) for your AP to test import into ProcureNow if you want — cc'd ProcureNow as an option.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBay Labs Finance <finance@brightbay.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence — procurement / VAT clarifications

Thanks Kim and Mina — quick answers: 

1) VAT: reverse-charge preferred. BrightBay VAT ID: IE6543210 (I've attached a VAT certificate). We will confirm validation screenshot by EOD.
2) Remit: BrightBay Treasury will pay from EU account — IBAN: IE29RBOS9300XXXXXX, SWIFT: RBOSIE2D, Account name: BrightBay Labs Ltd.
3) PO: PO-BB-2027-044 (please place on all commitment invoices).

ProcureNow: feel free to send the sample invoice import file for testing — cc'd.

I'll also queue a DocuSign signature for the MA schedule so we can trigger the deposit invoice once signed.

Best,
Liam

Attachment: BrightBay_VAT_certificate.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightbay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, ProcureNow Onboarding <procure@procurenow.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence — procurement / VAT clarifications

Liam / Team — great, thanks for the fast replies. Confirming operational plan and next actions: 

Operational plan (agreed):
- Invoice 1 (Deposit): EUR 192,000 (40%) issued upon DocuSign completion, invoice date = Nov 5, 2026, due net-30. Includes PO: PO-BB-2027-044. Reverse-charge will be applied (VAT line 0%, we will reference your VAT ID and reverse-charge on the PDF).
- Q1 invoice: EUR 96,000 invoiced Jan 3, 2027 (first business day) — recommended to align to EOM AP windows; receipt triggers internal tag for reserved capacity.
- Q2 invoice: EUR 96,000 invoiced Apr 3, 2027.
- Q3 invoice: EUR 48,000 invoiced Jul 3, 2027; Q4 invoice: EUR 48,000 invoiced Oct 3, 2027 with reconciliation.

Deliverables we will provide to you before each invoice:
- Monthly CSV ledger export (GL, PO, invoice id, line items) delivered to finance@brightbay.com
- One sample invoice PDF for AP import test (Kim will deliver the ProcureNow import file by tomorrow)
- Final signed MA and schedule will be attached to first invoice as evidence.

Next steps: 
1) Mina to send DocuSign MA link (DocuSign id included below) — once signed we will issue deposit invoice.
2) BrightBay to confirm VAT validation screenshot (Liam) and remit details are noted.
3) Kimberly to share ProcureNow import sample and the invoice PDF template.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/brightbay/MA-8342
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/8342

I'll kick off the DocuSign envelope now. If anything changes on the PO or remit, flag immediately so we can avoid payment delays.

Thanks — Mina
